title: Friendly Vanilla TP
description: Use your goat horns to teleport to your friends!
body:
![Friendly Vanilla TP](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/271952c096fcd9c40e7297dd749effbdd91ff0b1_0.webp)


> A Vanilla Friendly Teleport that gives you a way to teleport to your friends without commands or cheats!

![how to use](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/80ed87209e03ce1e24f67845a7951cf53ed52be0_0.webp)
> Rename a goat horn with the name of your friend and use it to teleport to him
